text:
I had my wisdom teeth removed with Dr. Nang. She and her assistants were very kind.

The wire was pushing into my cheek, causing a long-lasting wound. My previous clinic told me it was normally inserted, and then they left it there for a long time.
Here, the doctor asked if it hurt, but didn't ask, just ignored it. He asked if I could cut the wire. After the procedure, my mouth felt so comfortable that I wanted to transfer my orthodontic treatment to her. Haha.

I'm very afraid of anesthetic needles, and I already have low blood pressure.
The assistant offered me a hand to squeeze. The doctor said he would push the anesthetic very slowly so it wouldn't hurt.

During the procedure, the doctor and assistants kept asking if it hurt, not to tense up, if I could take a break, if my gums were numb.
"Breathe, don't hold your breath." The doctor explained in stages what to do next.
She's meticulous, works slowly, and doesn't rush. She prioritizes the patient's feelings and pain, rather than rushing through a large number of cases.
I was quoted nearly 5,000 baht per tooth at other places because I have a difficult-to-reach wisdom tooth.
Especially now that October has a promotion for wisdom tooth extraction, it's 2,500 baht.
Come here, it's cheap, I paid 2,700 baht and got medicine to take home.
The counter staff were friendly and helpful.
There's plenty of parking available along the street.
